violated_contract: A durable per-owner pending registry must not serialize expired ephemeral jobs through full worker dispatches, preventing executable work from reaching the owner.
canonical_prevention: Before dispatch, prove raw job-key absence under the per-job run lock, transactionally retire only exact unbound pending work and release its claim, and continue within a bounded retirement budget. Reconcile dispatching owners with the same fences; preserve flag-off behavior and measure retirement separately from transcription success.
